selection_reasoning: I selected 'find dark_oak_button' as the single atomic task. This is a straightforward observation/navigation task where the agent must locate a dark oak button placed somewhere in the scene. It is clearly observable and verifiable — the agent needs to have the dark_oak_button visible in its field of view or be within a certain proximity. It doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, just visual recognition and navigation. As a single task, no multi-hop dependency is needed, but the scene design can make it interesting by placing the button in a context that requires some exploration (e.g., on a wall inside a structure or partially hidden).

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate to the stone brick building, enter it, and visually observe the dark oak button on the interior back wall. The button is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 8). max_distance=5 is chosen because the building interior is only ~4 blocks deep, so 5 blocks requires the player to be at or inside the entrance (a distance of 16 would allow completion from spawn without entering the building, defeating the exploration purpose). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking toward the button, not just standing nearby facing away.

scene_description: A compact exploration scene with three structures: (1) A stone brick building at ~3-7/~0-3/~5-9 with a south-facing entrance and a dark oak button on the interior back wall, lit by glowstone; (2) An oak plank shed at ~-5 to ~-3/~0-2/~-3 to ~-1 with a wall torch; (3) A cobblestone pillar at ~-2 to ~0/~0-1/~3-5 with a decoy stone button. The player must explore the area, enter the stone brick building through its entrance, and locate the dark oak button on the back wall.
task_text: Find a dark oak button in the area. Explore the structures nearby and locate the dark oak button.
design_notes: The dark oak button is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 8) on the interior north wall of the stone brick building, facing south. The building entrance is a 3-wide, 3-tall opening on the south wall at z=5. Interior is lit by glowstone at (5, 2, 7). Two decoy structures provide visual complexity: an oak plank shed with a torch, and a cobblestone structure with a stone button (wrong type). The player must distinguish the dark oak button from the stone button decoy.
